commits.title: Stylesheet audiences: a script counts the classes only the admin, only Kaizena Flow's pages or only the on-site editor name

changes.how: Add `"postcss": "8.5.28"` to devDependencies: the version pnpm-lock.yaml resolves for @tailwindcss/postcss@4.3.3 (its snapshot at about line 4719 lists `postcss: 8.5.28`; the lockfile also holds 8.5.23 and 8.5.32 for other packages, which are not the one to use), written exactly, then run pnpm install so pnpm-lock.yaml gains only the importer line. It is already installed as a dependency of Tailwind's plugin, so nothing new is downloaded and nothing is paid. If src/lib/dependencies.scan.test.ts exists (step 1.8), add postcss to its PACKAGES with why 'parses the built stylesheet in stylesheet-audiences.mjs' and loads 'build'.

Plain Node ESM run from the repository root after pnpm build: 'node docs/audits/bloat-review-2026-11/scripts/stylesheet-audiences.mjs [--json]'. Imports: fs, path, zlib (brotliCompressSync with BROTLI_PARAM_QUALITY 11), postcss, and reach() from scripts/lib/import-walk.mjs (relative import '../../../../scripts/lib/import-walk.mjs'). Steps. (1) Find the sheets: every .css file under .next/static (walk it). The candidates are those whose text contains '.checkout-look'. The site's sheet is the candidate that does not contain '[data-builder-item]' when one such exists (after step 2.11 the admin has an entry of its own), else the only candidate; print its file name and its raw and Brotli bytes. Set split = true when two candidates exist. (2) Audiences by root layout. Group the root layouts so: store = src/app/s (every layout.tsx, page.tsx, route.ts and other .tsx file under it is an entry); platform = the folders src/app/(platform), (platform-nb), (docs), (docs-nb), (theme-preview), (theme-preview-nb); other = src/app/holding, passport, supply, sms and the files src/app/global-error.tsx and src/app/global-not-found.tsx plus every other top-level folder of src/app that is not admin, api or one of the above; admin = src/app/admin. For each group call reach(srcDir, entry, { dynamic: true }) (srcDir = path.resolve('src'); step 1.8's reach() returns a Map whose keys are the files reached, the entry included) from every file that sourceFiles(dir) of the same module returns for its folders, and collect the union of the Maps' keys. A reached file under src/components/admin/ or src/components/inline-edit/ that the store, platform or other group reaches counts for the audience 'editor' (the staff's on-site editor and the admin parts a public page draws), not for the group that reached it. (3) Tokens: for every file reached by any group read the text and split it at /[\s"'`<>{}()=;,]+/; drop tokens longer than 120 characters; keep a Map from token to the Set of audiences (store, platform, other, editor, admin) of the files that hold it. (4) Parse the site's sheet with postcss; take the at-rule 'layer' whose params start with 'utilities' and that has nodes; visit its rules, going into nested at-rules and wrapping a nested rule's text in its at-rule for the byte count. A rule's class is the first class in its selector, unescaped (\\: and the like). Its audience: 'store' when the token's set has store; else 'admin-only' when the set is exactly {admin}; else 'platform-only' when every member is platform or other; else 'editor-only' when exactly {editor} or {editor, admin}; else 'platform+editor'; a class no token matches is 'unknown'. (5) Print a table: audience, rules, raw bytes, Brotli bytes of that audience's rules joined; then the line 'no store page can draw: <raw> raw, <brotli> Brotli' for platform-only + editor-only + platform+editor together, and 'only admin files name: <raw> raw'. With --json print one object with the same numbers and the file name. (6) Exit 1 with a one-line reason when the 'no store page can draw' figure is above 17,000 bytes raw or above 2,000 bytes Brotli; and, only when split is true, when 'only admin files name' is above 0 (print the first 20 such classes). Otherwise exit 0. Keep every figure's computation in small exported functions at the top so the test below can import classAudience(set), overLine(numbers, split) and audienceTable(sheetCss, tokens) from this file: audienceTable takes the text of a sheet and a Map from token to Set of audiences, does steps (4) and (5) and returns { rows: { audience, rules, raw, brotli }[], noStoreRaw, noStoreBrotli, adminOnlyRaw }, where raw is the summed byte length of each rule's text as postcss's rule.toString() gives it (wrapped in its at-rule for a nested rule) (guard the main part with 'if (import.meta.url === pathToFileURL(process.argv[1]).href)').

Vitest, importing classAudience and overLine from '../../docs/audits/bloat-review-2026-11/scripts/stylesheet-audiences.mjs'. Cases: a set with store is 'store'; {admin} is 'admin-only'; {platform} and {platform, other} are 'platform-only'; {editor} and {editor, admin} are 'editor-only'; {platform, editor} is 'platform+editor'. overLine({ noStoreRaw: 16000, noStoreBrotli: 1900, adminOnlyRaw: 50000 }, false) is null (before the split the admin's share is printed, not failed); with noStoreRaw 17001 it is a string; with noStoreBrotli 2001 it is a string; overLine({ noStoreRaw: 0, noStoreBrotli: 0, adminOnlyRaw: 1 }, true) is a string that names the admin. A planted sheet for audienceTable: the text `@layer utilities{.a{color:red}.b{color:blue}.c{color:green}@media (min-width:40rem){.sm\:a{color:red}}}` with tokens new Map([['a', new Set(['store'])], ['b', new Set(['admin'])], ['c', new Set(['platform'])], ['sm:a', new Set(['editor'])]]): the rows give store 1 rule, admin-only 1, platform-only 1, editor-only 1; adminOnlyRaw equals the byte length of '.b{color:blue}' as postcss prints it (compute it in the test with postcss.parse('.b{color:blue}').first.toString().length); noStoreRaw is the sum for .c and the media-wrapped .sm\:a; a class with no token (add `.d{color:black}`) is 'unknown' and counts in no figure.

commits.title: Usage and limits reads the style text each store adds to every document, and how many published pages use motion

changes.how: Pure, no imports from src/server. Export const STYLE_MEDIAN_LINE = 10_000, STYLE_STORE_LINE = 20_000, MOTION_SHARE_LINE = 0.5. Export type StyleRow = { storeId: string | null; slug: string | null; name: string | null; cssBytes: number; pages: number; motionPages: number }. Export styleOver(row) = row.cssBytes > STYLE_STORE_LINE. Export styleSummary(rows): { stores: number; medianBytes: number; over: number; pages: number; motionPages: number; motionShare: number | null; triggers: ('median' | 'store' | 'motion')[] } : the median of cssBytes (0 for no rows), how many rows are over, the sums of pages and motionPages, motionShare = motionPages / pages or null when pages is 0, and triggers holding 'median' when medianBytes > STYLE_MEDIAN_LINE, 'store' when over > 0 and 'motion' when motionShare is not null and below MOTION_SHARE_LINE.

Cases: three rows of 1,000, 12,000 and 25,600 bytes give medianBytes 12000, over 1 and triggers containing 'median' and 'store'; a row of exactly 20,000 is not over and one of 20,001 is; 10 pages with 4 using motion give motionShare 0.4 and the trigger 'motion'; 10 with 5 give no 'motion' trigger; no rows give medianBytes 0, motionShare null and no trigger.

Starts with import 'server-only'. Export async function styleReading(): Promise<StyleRow[]>. One statement through typedRows() of src/server/typed-rows.ts (describe the row with col: store_id col.uuid.nullable(), slug and name col.textOrNull, css_bytes, pages and motion_pages col.int), no page document leaves the database. For stores: from commerce.stores s left join commerce.pages h on h.id = s.header_id left join commerce.pages f on f.id = s.footer_id, where not (s.is_template or s.starter or s.sandbox) (the same stores platformUsage() lists, but the house store stays in: do not filter s.house). css_bytes = octet_length(s.custom_css) + coalesce(octet_length(h.published->>'css'), 0) + coalesce(octet_length(f.published->>'css'), 0): the three sheets src/app/s/[store]/[market]/layout.tsx writes into every document with <CustomCss> (the store's, the header's, the footer's). pages = (select count(*)::int from commerce.pages p where p.store_id = s.id and p.type in ('page', 'article') and p.published is not null). motion_pages = the same count with and (jsonb_path_exists(p.published, '$.**.motion.enter') or jsonb_path_exists(p.published, '$.**.motion.hover') or jsonb_path_exists(p.published, '$.**.motion.scroll') or jsonb_path_exists(p.published, '$.**.backgroundMotion.effect') or jsonb_path_exists(p.published, '$.**.backgroundLayers[*].scroll') or jsonb_path_exists(p.published, '$.**.backgroundLayers[*].ambient')): the parts motionNeeds() in src/lib/motion-attrs.ts reads; an upper bound, said so in a comment. Union all one row for Kaizena Flow's own site with store_id, slug and name null: the same sums from commerce.platform_settings (custom_css, header_id, footer_id) and the pages where store_id is null. Order by css_bytes desc. Call longerTimeout(tx, 30) inside a transaction as src/db/client.ts describes, because the path test reads every published page once.

An integration test in the style of the other src/server/*.int.test.ts files (copy the store setup of one that inserts a store and a page, for example src/server/site-layouts.int.test.ts if it exists, else src/server/assistant-notices.int.test.ts for the store). Cases: (1) a test store whose custom_css is 25,000 characters of 'a{color:red}' repeated (under the 50,000 check) has cssBytes of at least 25,000 and styleOver() true: the mark. (2) the same store with a header page whose published is {"css": "x".repeat(3000), "rows": []} linked as header_id adds 3,000. (3) a published page of type 'page' with published = {"rows":[{"columns":[{"blocks":[{"type":"heading","motion":{"enter":{"effect":"fade"}}}]}]}]} counts in pages and motionPages; a second published page without motion counts in pages only; a draft counts in neither. (4) the row with storeId null is present once.

The page reads searchParams as 'query' already. Add: const reading = query.reading === 'styles' ? await styleReading() : null; (the reading is taken on demand, once a quarter, so the page's ordinary view sends no new statement). Below the database card add <Card title={w.platform.styles.title} compact>: a paragraph w.platform.styles.description; when reading is null a ButtonLink to `${BASE}?month=${month}&reading=styles` with prefetch={false} and the words w.platform.styles.take; when it is there: one line with the summary through fillWords (median, how many stores are over, the motion share as a whole percent, or w.platform.styles.noPages when the share is null), one line for each trigger of styleSummary(reading).triggers (w.platform.styles.triggers.median, .store, .motion), and a table with the columns store (the name, or w.platform.kaizen for the null row), style text (formatted with the page's existing formatUsage('storage_bytes', …) helper), a mark (the admin's existing warning badge or tone used on this page for a limit reached; the words w.platform.styles.over) on rows where styleOver(row), published pages, and pages with motion. Use the admin kit parts the page already imports (Card, the table part it uses for usage rows); write no new colour or class. Add 'reading?: string' to the page's searchParams type.

Inside platform: { ... } add styles: { title: 'Style text owners add', description: 'The CSS a store adds to every one of its documents: its own, its header\'s and its footer\'s. Read before opening and each quarter.', take: 'Take the reading', summary: 'Median {median} a store, {over} above 20 KB, {share}% of published pages use motion.', noPages: 'No published pages yet.', over: 'Above 20 KB', store: 'Store', bytes: 'Style text', pages: 'Published pages', motion: 'Pages with motion', triggers: { median: 'The median store is above 10 KB: look again at serving this CSS as an external stylesheet.', store: 'A store is above 20 KB: its sheets should move to one external hashed stylesheet.', motion: 'Under half of published pages use motion: load motion.css only where a page uses it (bloat review step 2.49).' } }. Leses før åpning og hvert kvartal.', take 'Ta avlesningen', summary 'Median {median} per butikk, {over} over 20 KB, {share} % av publiserte sider bruker bevegelse.', noPages 'Ingen publiserte sider ennå.', over 'Over 20 KB', store 'Butikk', bytes 'Stiltekst', pages 'Publiserte sider', motion 'Sider med bevegelse', triggers.median 'Medianbutikken er over 10 KB: se på nytt på å levere denne CSS-en som et eksternt stilark.', triggers.store 'En butikk er over 20 KB: stilarkene bør flyttes til ett eksternt stilark med hash.', triggers.motion 'Under halvparten av publiserte sider bruker bevegelse: last motion.css bare der en side bruker den (trinn 2.49 i gjennomgangen).'
